identity_and_evidence.power: No MW is inferred from declared valuation, floor area, occupancy, or permit type. Permit does not prove construction start, temporary rental need, supply gap, or buying authority.

limitations_and_handoff: The source's 664,565 historical rows are not the retrieved opportunity corpus. This adapter covers only the recent 90-day issued-date window, not all history or all Boston permits outside this dataset.

Rows with Closed status remain in observations and evidence; the assessment rejects them for current Signal admission. Open is retained verbatim and only permits an assessment to consider the explicit work description; it does not mean work started.
Rows older than the rolling issue-date window are no longer polled, so later status changes to older permits are not monitored by this source.
